{"step":5,"file":"src/lib/lwan-config.c","function":"parse_config","line":646,"var":"lexeme->type","code":"case LEXEME_OPEN_BRACKET: return parse_section;","note":"The parser switches from top-level parsing into section parsing on the attacker-controlled token stream."},

{"step":7,"file":"src/lib/lwan-config.c","function":"parse_section_shorthand","line":624,"var":"next_state","code":"void *next_state = parse_section(parser);","note":"A shorthand section reuses the same parsing machinery and then immediately emits a section-end marker."}
